text:
maria: Quick follow-up from the metering postmortem — we still have 3 open remediation items (token miscounts, delayed ingestion, invoice credits). Owners, can you confirm status and ETA? cc @aj @kevin @samir
aj: I own the token counting fix (PR #412). Deployed a hotfix to staging yesterday. Need one more load test before promoting to prod. ETA: EOD Thu.
kevin: Delayed ingestion root cause looks like the SQS consumer checkpoint edge-case on retries. I have a patch and a canary plan — will run a 2-hour canary tomorrow then full rollout if green. ETA: Fri AM.
samir: Invoice corrections: finance has 18 affected customers needing credits. I can't finalize memos until we confirm corrected usage after kevin's fix. Tentative credits issuance: next Mon.
billing-bot: Reminder: Scheduled billing export for March at 03:00 UTC — will hold export until ingestion backlog is cleared.
aj: Load test summary from staging: token counts within expected tolerance (mismatch_rate: 0.002). Logs: ```errors:0, mismatch_rate:0.002, samples:100k```
kevin: Can you paste the aggregation query you used? I'll run the same against canary. My plan: ```SELECT customer_id, SUM(tokens) AS tokens FROM usage WHERE ts >= '2026-03-01' GROUP BY 1;```
aj: Using processed flag windowing. Snippet I ran: ```WITH agg AS (SELECT customer_id, SUM(tokens) AS tokens FROM raw_usage WHERE processed = true GROUP BY 1) SELECT * FROM agg WHERE tokens > 0;```
samir: Action items recap: 1) aj -> promote hotfix to prod after 2h load pass (ETA Thu EOD). 2) kevin -> canary + full rollout for ingestion (ETA Fri AM). 3) samir -> final invoice recalculation + issue credits (ETA Mon). 4) ops -> set recurring alert for ingestion lag > 1h. Who owns ops followup?
opsbot: Ops alert created: rule ingestion-lag > 1h -> notifies #eng-infra oncall. Rule ID: OL-778.
kevin: I'll own the ops followup to harden the SQS consumer and update the runbook. Created tracker issue INF-2310 and will attach rollout notes.
maria: Please add ETAs to the postmortem action tracker doc and tag me. Scheduling a 15m check-in Friday 09:30 PT — if anything slips, flag immediately.
aj: :thumbsup: Added PR link and will update tracker after the canary pass.
samir: I'll prepare credit memo drafts and loop in finance for approvals once counts are verified.
kevin: Note for postmortem: spotted two customers with recurring delayed token spikes during peak window — likely tied to batch_size config. I'll include that as a recurring incident pattern and propose mitigation.
maria: Good catch. Add it to recurrence section and propose dynamic batch sizing mitigation.
aj: I also propose a weekly reconcile job that automatically compares raw vs processed counts and raises a ticket if variance > 0.5%. I'll prototype.
maria: Closing the loop: everyone, add items to the tracker by Thu EOD. We'll confirm in Friday's check-in. Thanks all.
